verdict_reason: Mixed signal, same pattern as GBBL: cheap on smoothed 10yr earnings, pricier than what this stock has typically traded at over its own history. Present PE sits mid-band, not at either extreme.
devils_advocate: FY082-083 EPS (20.93) is a ~58% jump off FY081-082's 13.24, the lowest print in the whole series, after a multi-year slide (17.69→14.48→13.24) through 079-082. That decline sits inside the 10yr Shiller window, dragging the average down and making today's PE look cheap by comparison — denominator effect, not necessarily genuine value. Also: SHINE is a four-time serial acquirer (Resunga 2069, Gaumukhi 2073, Bhargav+Purnima 2076) — each merger expanded paid-up capital and diluted EPS mechanically, so its own 14yr PE history isn't a clean apples-to-apples band.
